newsitem.title: ITALY: Specialists bid for 8.0 bln lire of Italy CTZ.
newsitem.headline: Specialists bid for 8.0 bln lire of Italy CTZ.

text.p: Specialist bond traders bid for and were allocated 8.0 billion lire of two-year zero coupon certificates (CTZ) against the Italian Treasury's offer of 200 billion lire of paper.
Earlier, the Treasury received bids for 3.293 trillion lire at the open auction for the October 31, 1998 paper against two trillion lire worth of certificates on offer.
The auction price was set at 89.55 from 89.10 at the previous CTZ sale on December 11. Gross yield was 6.14 percent against 6.31 percent previously.
